KSC-04pd0049.title: KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, FLA. -- An alligator is spotted sunning on the muddy bank of a canal in KSC.  Nearly 5,000 alligators can be found in canals, ponds, and waterways throughout the Center and the surrounding Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge. American alligators feed and rest in the water, and lay their eggs in dens they dig into the banks. The young alligators spend their first several weeks in these dens. The Wildlife Refuge encompasses 92,000 acres that are a habitat for more than 331 species of birds, 31 mammals, 117 fishes, and 65 amphibians and reptiles.

KSC-04pd0044.title: KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, FLA. -- A group of white pelicans spend a few moments relaxing in the water near the Vehicle Assembly Building at Kennedy Space Center. Found from British Columbia south to western Ontario, California and the Texas coast, white pelicans winter from Florida south to Panama. They prefer marshy lakes and coastal regions, and winter chiefly in coastal lagoons. White pelicans are one of 310 species of birds that inhabit the Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge, which shares a boundary with KSC. The marshes and open water of the refuge also provide wintering areas for 23 species of migratory waterfowl, as well as a year-round home for great blue herons, great egrets, wood storks, cormorants, brown pelicans and other species of marsh and shore birds.

KSC-03pd2984.title: KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, FLA.   -   A great blue heron patiently stalks its prey in the marshes around KSC. The marshes and open water of the refuge also provide wintering areas for 23 species of migratory waterfowl, as well as a year-round home for great blue herons, great egrets, wood storks, cormorants, brown pelicans and other species of marsh and shore birds.

gpt2_fp16_forward.arithmetic:
GPT-2 small computed in fp16: every stored value is IEEE binary16 and every operation rounds to it. Dot products
    (numpy's float16 matmul, which has no BLAS) keep a float32 accumulator and round the result to fp16: exactly what
    the chip's TensorFMA16A32 does (fp16 operands, fp32 accumulator). Numpy's float16 functions compute exp and tanh in
    float32 and round. The causal mask is -inf (fp16 cannot hold -1e10).

gpt2_bf16_forward.arithmetic:
GPT-2 small computed in bfloat16, as AVX-512 BF16 or a GPU's bf16 does: operands on the bf16 grid, dot products
    with a float32 accumulator, every stored result rounded to bf16 (rb). Held in float32 bytes.

gpt2_l11_down_maxabs.source: openai-community/gpt2@607a30d783dfa663caf39e06633721c8d4cfcd7e, text: Pride and Prejudice (real.json text), tokens 0-127

window.rule: the one of 20 seeded aligned windows nearest their median (sum of |x - median| / MAD over window_choice.statistics)

A.scheme: per tensor, symmetric, scale = max|x| / 127, round half to even, clip +-127

B.scheme: per output channel (column of the (in, out) weight), symmetric, scale_j = max_k |W[k, j]| / 127, round half to even, clip +-127

window.rule: the window of int8/gpt2_l11_down_maxabs, so the pair differs only in the calibration

A.scheme: TFLite int8 activations: per tensor, asymmetric, s = (hi - lo) / 255 with lo <= 0 <= hi, z = round(-128 - lo / s), code = clip(round(x / s) + z, -128, 127)
A.what_the_card_computes: sum(code * B) = sum(x / s * B) + z * sum(B): the true integer product plus a per-column constant a deployed kernel subtracts afterwards
